source_locations.text: List-attribute lead-in; says attributes control Lbl interpretation and ContinuedList/ContinuedFrom control L relative to non-parent L elements.
Table 382; ListNumbering values/default/order classification and continuation fields; NOTE on optional extraction autonumbering and explicit Lbl labels.

features.norm: Optional, inheritable; the listed value classifies L as ordered or unordered, specifies numbering/symbol scheme and language-dependent alphabet. Default None; ordered iff value is Ordered, Decimal, UpperRoman, LowerRoman, UpperAlpha or LowerAlpha.
features.reader_relevance: The ordered/unordered classification is source-defined list semantics. The NOTE says an extraction tool may autonumber and warns Lbl can already carry explicit results; it supports avoiding duplicate label generation, but does not itself waive the table's classification rule.
features.implementation: Not read by Tree::attribute/list_continuation or viewer-core gathering. All standard Lists map to one generic List role; no ordered/unordered property crosses the public accessibility tree.
features.assertions: No ListNumbering assertion found in implementation tests; existing list tests cover continuation only.

features.norm: Optional, PDF 2.0, not inheritable by EC3 #346; boolean default false. If true and ContinuedFrom absent, predecessor is preceding list at same structure depth.
features.implementation: Tree::list_continuation and list_predecessors; carries flag to AccessibilityNode; viewer-accessibility publishes continuation text. Existing source-derived model, headless, and tree tests cover explicit and fallback behavior.
features.assertions: Existing list continuation tests assert data and rendered accessible description/FlowTo; this shard did not re-audit their fixture internals.

features.norm: Optional PDF 2.0 ID byte string, not inheritable by EC3 #346; names earlier L by its /ID.
features.implementation: Resolved over structure walk by list_predecessors, carried as index and exposed as AT-SPI FlowTo when predecessor is in answer.
features.assertions: Existing list continuation tests; no new draft because prior shard covers this behavior.

features.ledger: Implemented row 14.8.5.5 currently names the two continuation fields; its ListNumbering-inapplicable rationale is limited to renumbering/explicit Lbl marks and does not separately account for Table 382's ordered-vs-unordered classification.

source_locations.text: Lead-in: defines an accessibility mechanism for non-interactive forms; Form elements enclose each content set; roles and values are defined through PrintField.
Table 383: Role, tv content rule, grouping recommendation, default role; Checked/checked states and default; Desc alternate field name.

features.norm: Optional, noninheritable. rb/radio, cb/check box, pb/pushbutton, tv/text-value, lb/listbox. tv is for noninteractive textual values; value shall be the Form element's content. Related noninteractive field groupings should be enclosed in Part.
features.implementation: pdf-model::Tree::print_field parses role (including all five names); no production caller. Viewer accessibility nodes do not carry this information to a consumer.
features.assertions: pdf-model unit test a_flattened_form_field_says_what_it_was checks cb/rb/tv parser results only; no public-viewer/assistive consumer assertion.

features.norm: Optional, noninheritable; on/off/neutral; lowercase alias deprecated in PDF 2.0; default off. State is for radio/check-box fields.
features.implementation: Parser gives current capitalization priority, reads deprecated spelling, defaults to Off. Not consumed or published after parsing.
features.assertions: Model test checks current on, deprecated neutral, default off; lacks end-to-end use.

features.norm: Optional, noninheritable text-string alternate field name, analogous to interactive field /TU.
features.implementation: Parser decodes it; no production caller and no accessibility-tree mapping.
features.assertions: Model test checks a decoded check-box description; no user-visible assertion.

features.ledger: Implemented row 14.8.5.6 overstates consumer coverage: listed code is parser/model only, while the clause expressly identifies an accessibility mechanism and currently no caller publishes the parsed values.

source_locations.text: RowSpan, ColSpan, Headers (including recursive association and order), Scope and default axis algorithm.
Summary and Short: type applicability and nonvisual/screen-reader usage.

features.norm: Noninheritable cell/header semantics; span defaults 1; Headers names TH IDs, row IDs then column IDs most-specific-first and recursively inherits referenced TH Headers; Scope is Row/Column/Both for TH only, with source algorithm when absent.
features.implementation_and_assertions: Substantially covered by existing model/headless/AT-SPI tests cited in ledger 14.8.5.7; overlapping prior shards intentionally not repeated here.

features.norm: Noninheritable. Summary applies only to Table and is for nonvisual rendering. Short applies only to TH as a short replacement form used when repeating headers.
features.implementation_and_assertions: Substantially covered by existing source-derived model/headless/tree tests cited in ledger 14.8.5.7; no new issue raised in this bounded shard.

features.ledger: No new discrepancy identified in the reviewed source-to-test map; prior table-attribute shards contain deeper assertion review.

source_locations.text: Artifact owner restriction; Type values/descriptions; BBox.
Subtype values and should-only-use-with-Pagination-or-Inline guidance; Annex E extensibility.

features.norm: Artifact-owned/nonstandard owner restrictions are stated in §14.8.5.8 lead-in; Table 385 defines Type, user-space BBox, and Subtype. EC3 #346 marks Table 385 entries noninheritable. Subtype's condition is a should, not a shall.
features.implementation_and_assertions: Tree::artifact/attributes.rs plus viewer accessibility publication; existing model/headless/AT-SPI tests and ADR 0743 were previously reviewed. Not re-audited beyond confirming table rows and locators.

features.ledger: No additional discrepancy raised. Avoided repeating prior artifact/attributeStream coverage.

errata.effect: Adds not-inheritable status to the two continuation entries and Table 385 entries. Does not alter Table 382 ListNumbering inheritance or the Table 383 statuses.
